title: Disability Compensation: Ending a Dependent's Recognition and the Resulting Overpayment
content:
**Effective date of a removal.** A dependent is removed from a Disability Compensation award effective:

| Event | Removal effective |
|---|---|
| Divorce | Last day of the month in which the divorce occurred |
| Death of the dependent | Last day of the month in which the death occurred |
| Marriage of a child | Last day of the month in which the marriage occurred |
| Child reaches the child age limit | The day before the child age-limit birthday, unless the child is then added as a school child |
| School child reaches the school-child age limit | The day before the school-child age-limit birthday |
| School attendance ends | Last day of the month in which school attendance ended |

The first entitlement month paid at the lower rate is the month after the effective date.

**Channels.** A removal may be reported by telephone, online or by mail, because a report that reduces benefits is accepted orally.

**Once only.** A dependent addition is removed only once. Whether an addition has already been removed is read from the award's dependency records: an addition that already has a removal recorded against it is not removed again.

**Overpayment.** When monthly payments that still included the removed dependent's addition were issued for entitlement months on or after the removal's first lower-rate month, the removal records an overpayment equal to that dependent's monthly addition for the tier in effect, multiplied by the number of such months, and a Disability Compensation Overpayment debt is established for it with Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery. The months counted are the monthly payments on the same award, from that first lower-rate month through the most recent monthly payment, whose gross amount still includes the removed dependent's addition.

**Worked example (hypothetical).** An award at Disability Compensation (60% Combined Rating) recognizes a spouse; the divorce occurs on 14 March, so the removal is effective 31 March and the first month paid at the lower rate is April. The monthly payments for April, May and June were issued still including the spouse addition of 132.18. The overpayment is 132.18 multiplied by 3, that is 396.54, and a Disability Compensation Overpayment debt is established for 396.54.

**Example with no overpayment (hypothetical).** If the same divorce is reported before any payment for April is issued, no payment for a month on or after April includes the addition, the count is nothing, and no overpayment is recorded.
